fields.FIR_Description: It was alleged that the complainant received messages threatening to circulate private material online unless Rs. 10,000 was paid. The matter was brought to Madurai Central PS on 2026-05-27, while the incident was placed on 2026-05-27 at roughly 14:00. Mythili Selvi reported the matter orally at Madurai Central PS; the contact number given was 9000000244. Murugan Sundaram (9000000207) noticed the incident and may be able to provide a statement. The complainant mentioned the account SYN-ACC-100090 as the destination of the transfer. A person named Udhay Anand, associated with the number 9000000125, was mentioned as potentially relevant to the incident. No supporting material was reported at the time of registration. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00391, as the mobile number 9000000125 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Suspect allegedly used online messages to demand money.
fields.Keywords: blackmail, online threat, afternoon, receiving account, shopping complex, suspect, witness, mobile number
